description: Field units and dynamics from the radar's own outputs and the car's gyro / odometry: the lateral unit with the lever arm fixed from vehicle geometry, the 0x196 required-deceleration formula, TRACKER_B while the ACC target coasts, and the filter dynamics of 84|10 / 96|10 / ACC REL_ACCEL. Owner car, issue #66 car and a third car; held-out logs where stated.

lateral_unit_rotation.authority: physical through the gyro and the odometry-checked 0x680 range; assumes the lever arm, gyro scale and negligible sideslip

required_decel_0x196.form: floor(a_req / 0.095); a_req = -v_e^2 / (2 (r - 1.75 + v_l^2 / 2|a_l|)) when the lead stops, else a_l - vRel^2 / (2 (r - 1.75)); 0x195 range / speed / accel, ego speed 0.15 s old, no ego-acceleration term
required_decel_0x196.open: lead-moving branch 38 % exact in the fleet; |a_lead| > 3 m/s^2; TTC < 1.5 s

84|10.model: first-order low-pass of the track's own 64|10 acceleration
84|10.over_ground: parked objects +2-3 codes per m/s^2 of ego acceleration (a relative reading would give -12 to -20)
